explanation: Rebating gives unfair inducement outside policy contract. It is an unfair trade practice that is unlawful in most states.

distractorExplanations.b: Paying commission to an unlicensed person is a separate licensing violation, not a rebate to the policyowner.
distractorExplanations.c: Inducing replacement through misrepresentation is twisting, not rebating.

prompt: Estoppel may prevent an insurer from denying coverage when:

Disability and health insurance predicting sickness/injury incidence

prompt: Anti-selection occurs when:

Higher-risk individuals seek insurance more than lower-risk individuals
